application_baseline.working_tree_note: Reports-only branch created from origin/main; application files not modified

methodology.implementation_vs_operational: Implementation scores code existence and wiring. Operational scores production-verified behavior. Implemented-but-unverified caps operational fraction at 0 or 0.25-0.5. Blocked+unverified operational = 0.
methodology.overall_definition: GENEL and TEKNİK = weighted implementation of systems A-M. OPERASYONEL = weighted operational of A-M. SATIŞA = sales-readiness operational (system N), with launch-critical subset reported separately.
methodology.weight_changes: None. Suggested weights used as specified.
methodology.tests_policy: Unrun tests are NOT TESTED, never PASS.
